operations.title: Operations
operations.name: Title
operations.noPublishedProcesses: No published procedures are available. Publish a procedure before creating a request.
operations.noTargets: No records are available for this procedure.
operations.stageOrderHelp: Stages are reviewed in order. One assigned reviewer approves each stage; the requester cannot review their own request.
operations.stagesAfterSubmit: Approval stages appear when the request is submitted.
operations.editPublishedNotice: Saving changes returns the procedure to draft for publication. Submitted requests keep their existing stages and reviewers.
operations.publishHelp: The procedure becomes available for new requests after publication.
operations.archiveHelp: The procedure will no longer accept new requests. Existing requests keep their history.
operations.notEditable: Only the requester can edit a draft or returned request.
operations.reasonHelp: Your decision and comment are saved in the request history.
operations.submitHelp: Submission saves the procedure stages and reviewers and starts approval.
operations.approveHelp: The request advances to the next stage and completes after the final approval.

confirm.return: Return this request to its requester?

operations.noHistory: Approval history starts when the request is submitted.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action
errors.save: Could not save changes. Try again.
errors.conflict: This record has changed. Refresh and review it before trying again.
errors.executionFailed: The request could not be completed and the final approval was not saved. Review the record and explicitly try again.
errors.reviewerNotEligible: One of the chosen reviewers lacks the operations review capability. Grant it or pick someone else, then publish again.

operations.reloadDraft: Refresh data and replace this draft?
operations.reloadDraftHelp: Your unsaved changes will be replaced with the latest record.
operations.purposeHint: Controls where new requests appear. Existing requests keep their original purpose.

personal.title: My requests
personal.description: Your employment service requests and their progress.
personal.returned: This request was returned for you to complete.

operations.stageApprovalModeHint: When the same reviewer sits on consecutive stages: «Approve each stage» asks for a separate decision per stage, and «One approval is enough» approves their consecutive stages in one decision. Submitted requests keep the mode they were submitted under.
operations.archivedNotEditable: An archived procedure cannot be edited.
